description: This file contains the implementation of a DHTML Calendar widget, including its constructor, methods for rendering, event handling, date parsing, and display logic. It defines a Calendar class with various functionalities for date selection and UI interactions.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Main class implementing a DHTML calendar widget with date selection, display, and interaction features.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the calendar's current date and reinitializes the display.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the calendar display based on the current date.

methods.name: showAt
methods.description: Shows the calendar at specified x and y coordinates.

methods.name: showAtElement
methods.description: Displays the calendar relative to a DOM element with optional positioning options.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the date format string for displaying selected dates.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string according to a specified format and sets the calendar date.
